statement: ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ ell.toNat → (y ^ n) v ≠ 0
proof:
have hell : (ell.toNat : ℤ) = ell := Int.toNat_of_nonneg h_H001.2.2.1
intro n
induction n with
| zero => simpa using h_H003.1
| succ n ih =>
  intro hn hz
  have hn' : n ≤ ell.toNat := by omega
  have hcoef : (n + 1 : ℂ) * ((ell : ℂ) - (n + 1 : ℕ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    have he : ell - (n : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by omega
    have he' : (ell : ℂ) - (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast he
    have hh : (ell : ℂ) - (n + 1 : ℕ) + 1 = (ell : ℂ) - (n : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hh]
    exact mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)) he'
  have hr := h_T001.2 (n + 1) (by omega)
  rw [hz, map_zero, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hr
  exact ih hn' ((smul_eq_zero.mp hr.symm).resolve_left hcoef)
